items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Because it happened to Larry Adler.

ctx.x: You come to a point and then there's a sort of stagnation -- where a new break through has to come along in some way, is this what was happening in the '40's?
Yeah, typecasting -- typecasting was becoming very popular. See? Because it happened to Larry Adler.

What were the new break throughs at this time, on the horizon, could you see them at all, when you look back now, tap dancing that sort of -- there was hope then, this is the new break through and people started coming back into it now and started --
